data.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: Promote to AC verify lines (move from cycle-1 review comment into the AC checklist): (a) 'pre_cutover.py dynamic-ref check returns zero hits' — Verify: python3 -c 'import ast; src=open("plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/pre_cutover.py").read(); tree=ast.parse(src); hits=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Str) and any(name in n.s for name in ["bootstrap","orphan_band","duplicates_band","stale_band","open_count_skew_band"])]; assert not hits, hits'. (b) Importlib smoke test post-deletion — Verify: python3 -c 'import plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.reconcile; import plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.__main__'. Migration note for backward_compat (minor): Keep --strict as opt-in (do NOT invert the default). CI workflow invokes the script WITH --strict; local tooling invocations without flags retain advisory-default exit-0 behavior. This preserves backward compatibility of existing local invocations.
